razonamiento: CloudFormation (b1) was omitted per Rule 7 because it is a deployment/management tool with no runtime connections drawn or spoken. UserCompanyDataStream (b4) represents the on-premises linear operations and broadcast center (prem), and UserCompanyEdge (b5) represents the distribution uplink/affiliates. EC2 incorporates Evertz ORT software and Auto Scaling mentioned in the narration.
